newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Innovest in timber, land talks.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Innovest in timber, land talks.

text.p: Property developer and timber company Innovest Bhd has announced that it is in negotiations with a "foreign government" over a "possible acquisition of a timber concession."
The announcement was made in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) on Friday. It did not give any details.
The statement was made after Innovest requested the suspension of its shares from trading on the KLSE on September 20.

Innovest also reiterated that it was holding on-going negotiations with the Perak state government for the private development of a 4,000-ha (9,900-acre) site in the state. Innovest anounced the project, reported to be worth 20 billion ringgit, in May.
Officials from the company could not be reached for comment.
Innovest stock was last traded on September 20, closing at 10.50 ringgit.
